high_level_description: This image captures a lively scene at Pacific Park, a popular amusement park located on the Santa Monica Pier in California. The setting is vibrant and sunny, with clear blue skies overhead. In the foreground, two individuals are standing close together on the wooden boardwalk of the pier. The person on the left appears to be an older man wearing a dark cap, sunglasses, a gray t-shirt, and light blue jeans. He has his hands in his pockets and is looking towards the camera.
